about: Shared by the live view (1f3d9-live, test/fixtures/browser-mutes-fixture.json) and the city window tests. Copy this file byte for byte into both repositories and never change one copy alone. parse: each stored raw value (null means nothing stored) and the list it must give. judge: with places as the place list and items as the list in force, whether the subject is hidden.

parse.name: a good list keeps its order
id above the largest city id
an entry that is not an object
duplicates keep the last choice, in the order of last appearance
the founder cannot be muted: an entry naming resident 1 is dropped
a list naming only the founder is empty
the second founder cannot be muted: an entry naming resident 2 is dropped
a list naming both founders is empty
an allow on the second founder is dropped
a place numbered 2 is not a founder
a note numbered 1 is not the founder
an allow on a resident or a kind is kept but changes nothing
one over the cap of 1000 entries
